cluster_stories.title: The pro-Anthropic protest
cluster_stories.summary: The Ban RSI protest at Anthropic’s IPO was encouraging: well-attended, covered by media, high-energy. It was focused on a single message – that we should ban AI systems that are capable of building more capable AI systems. It was a promising outcome for a protest planned only a couple of days in advance. But there was something weird about it, something I couldn’t put my finger on while it was going on. It was only when I read Michel Justen’s reporting on the protest, Anthropic is running out of friends, that I realized what my problem was.The protest was way too friendly to Anthropic.Mixed messagesThe signs at the protest were a mix. There were signs you’d expect at a protest to ban RSI (“regulate AI now”, “freeze AI now”). cluster_stories.headline: Protesters Demand Ban on AI Systems at Anthropic IPO
